affiliations.date_precision: The exact full-name and restricted-identifier Army-entry record carries occupation code 097 on February 21, 1941. The residual category names no exact role, employer, workplace, or Army-to-OSS transition.
affiliations.research_notes: The official residual category is preserved without inventing a managerial title, organization, industry, or employment relationship.

affiliations.date_precision: The exact full-name and restricted-identifier Army-entry record carries occupation code 992 on July 15, 1943. The historical category identifies student status but names no school, employer, course, or Army-to-OSS transition.
affiliations.research_notes: Student status is not classified as employment. No school is inferred from namesake, cemetery, genealogy, or local-history results.

affiliations.date_precision: The exact restricted-identifier Army-entry record carries occupation code 266 on February 20, 1945. It names no police department, agency, exact role, employer, workplace, or Army-to-OSS transition.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Alfonso J. Carrillo Jr. is confirmed as the Army private whose official entry record matches the OSS index's full name and restricted identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The two official records agree on full name, suffix, and restricted identifier; the Army record documents entry as a private on February 21, 1941.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact full-name, suffix, and restricted-identifier agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity and Army entry, not the date or terms of OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The restricted identifier is withheld. Cemetery, genealogy, and modern namesakes lack the identifier and are rejected.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Harry D. Carroll is confirmed as the Army private whose official entry record matches the OSS index's restricted identifier.

claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity and Army entry, not the date or terms of OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The restricted identifier is withheld. Four other Harry D. Carroll Army candidates have different identifiers and are rejected. A postwar Portsmouth business-directory lead lacks an identifier or OSS bridge and is not used.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Rene A. Carrie in Box 109 without a rank or restricted identifier. Columbia University documents historian Rene Albrecht-Carrie, but no official or independent source connects that person to OSS or Box 109. The famous-name candidate remains unaccepted.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 109 for a full middle name, education, birth data, rank, or assignment that can test the Rene Albrecht-Carrie candidate and establish pre-OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

research_attempts.query_text: Rene A Carrie, Rene Albrecht-Carrie, and diacritic and hyphen variants; visually checked NARA index; Army bulk exact-name review; NARA Catalog context; CIA Reading Room; LoC current API; Columbia finding aid; exact-name OSS, historian, professor, employer, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Columbia documents historian Rene Albrecht-Carrie's education and postwar academic employment, but neither that finding aid nor any independent source links him to OSS or Box 109. A CIA PDF mentions only his book. Other results are namesakes or semantic noise.
research_attempts.research_notes: The famous candidate is retained only as a review lead, not as an identity or affiliation claim. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified; no authenticated NARA Catalog request was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 109 for identity anchors that can test the Rene Albrecht-Carrie candidate.
